# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before making changes, read `AGENTS.md` and follow it as the authoritative repository workflow.

Also read `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`, `docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, and `docs/AI_HANDOFF.md`.

Never mark a change as completed in `CHANGELOG.md` unless it has been verified. Keep planned or unverified work in project state/plan documents instead.
